summary: BKV issued $575M of 1.625% convertible senior notes due 2031 via a private 8-K, including a fully exercised $75M option. Net proceeds of ~$554.7M will fund ~$64.7M capped calls and $35M for 1.45M share repurchases at $24.10, with the remainder for general purposes. Semi-annual interest starts April 2027; conversion is contingent pre-July 2031. The combined debt raise and buyback is a capital structure event, not an M&A deal. Watch for conversion price details, buyback pace, and leverage impact.
